senses.gloss:
खेल् खेल्, i. 1, Par.
 1. To move to and fro, Rām. 5, 55, 26 (to dance?).
 --Caus. To put in motion, to turn, Pañc. 221, 12.

खेल खेल् + अ,
 I. adj. Moving from one side to the other, swinging, moving gently, MBh. 1, 7043; Vikr. d. 95.
 II. ˚लम्, adv. Moving gently, Rām. 2, 60, 19.
 --Comp.
खेलन खेल् + अन, n. Moving to and fro, Gīt. 1, 40.
खेलि खेल् + इ, f. Play, Gīt. 11, 30.
